name: Terrarium 120x40x50 +3D
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 120x40x50 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 240.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: At 120 cm, this is our longest standard terrarium of full depth. The floor measures 120x40 cm, or 4800 cm², the height is 50 cm and the volume is about 240 liters. The back wall carries a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam shaped like rock or bark.

The twenty extra centimeters of length compared with the one-meter models show best in the temperature gradient: the distance between the basking spot and the cool hide is greater, so the animal chooses its temperature more precisely. An adult bearded dragon has the minimum floor with a margin in length. A blue-tongued skink and a ball python use the length, and 50 cm of height leaves room for deeper substrate.

A 120 cm terrarium needs a cabinet of the same length and a route to the room checked in advance, so measure the doors and the hallway. If you want a width of 50 cm instead of 40, we build it to order in 7 to 14 days. You choose the film for the outer sides from 34 patterns. We ship it by courier throughout Serbia, with the background already fitted.
